full_judgment:
Mr. S. K. Sinha J: Plaintiff obtained this Rule against the Judgment and decree dated 14.10.92 of the learned Additional District Judge, Naogaon in Title Appeal No. 185 of 1988 reversing those dated 29.8.1988 of the learned Assistant Judge, Naogaon, in Other Class Suit No. 820 of 1983. 

 4. The learned Assistant Judge upon consideration of the evidence on record by judgment and order dated 29.8.88 decreed the suit. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree, the opposite party preferred title appeal No. 185 of 1988. The learned Additional District Judge, who heard the said appeal by judgment and decree-dated 14,10.92 allowed the appeal and set aside those of the learned Assistant Judge. 

 11. In the result, the Rule is made absolute without any order as to costs. The judgment and decree dated 14.10.92 of the learned Additional District Judge in Title Appeal No. 185 of 1988 reversing those dated 29.8.88 of the learned Assistant Judge, Naogaon in Other Class Suit No. 820 of 1983 are set aside and restored those of the trial court.
